scope: Finite checks only; general mathematical proof and assumptions remain in current account. No global exact LP implementation.

literal_gap.scope: Finite exact schedules from given feasible source literal-LP witnesses. Every job edge and every actual machine load is recounted separately. No exact LP solver, OPT oracle, universal-proof or novelty certification. Original-P builder and Hall matcher are reused, not independent.

single_row.scope: Single-row finite audit; all original configurations enumerated only for k<=4. SciPy provides candidate supports/infeasibility flags; positive supports and negative separating inequalities are certified over Fraction. The general theorem rests on the explicit constructive proof, not these tests.
